title: As soon as, again and again
goal: Say that one thing followed another at once with -An badyna, and that an action went on and on with a converb said twice.

intro.text: `-An badyna` means **as soon as**: *Öýe gelen badyna uklady* (she fell asleep as soon as she got home). A converb said twice, with a hyphen, is an action repeated or drawn out: *dura-dura* (standing and standing), *gaýtalap-gaýtalap* (repeating over and over).

vocab.en: as soon as (after a verb in -An)
in time, in the end (literally going and going)

exercises.question: How do you say **as soon as I heard**?

why.2: *Eşidenden soň* is **after I heard**, maybe a while after.

exercises.en: As soon as the film ended, the hall emptied.

exercises.prompt: She fell asleep as soon as she got home.
exercises.explain: *Öýe gelen badyna* (as soon as she got home), then *uklady*.

exercises.prompt: Bu habary eşiden badyna, kakama jaň etdim.
accept: As soon as I heard this news, I called my father.
As soon as I heard [this|the] news, I [phoned|rang] my [father|dad].
As soon as I heard [this|the] news, I called my dad.
As soon as I heard the news, I called my father.
I [called|phoned|rang] my [father|dad] as soon as I heard [this|the] news.

exercises.question: *Öýe gelen badyna* or *öýe gelenden soň*: what does *badyna* add?

why.2: The opposite: *badyna* says the second action comes at once.

exercises.explain: *Gelenden soň*: after coming. *Gelen badyna*: as soon as, right then.

exercises.en: I got tired from standing so long.

reject.why: Both halves have the same shape: *dura-dura*.

exercises.prompt: I learn new words by repeating them over and over.

reject.why: That is just **by repeating**. For **over and over**, say it twice: *gaýtalap-gaýtalap*.

exercises.explain: *gaýtalap-gaýtalap*: `-(Y)p` said twice, repeating again and again.

accept: You will understand [eventually|in the end|with time|sooner or later].
[In time|Eventually|In the end|With time], you will understand.
You will get it in time.

exercises.prompt: As soon as the teacher came in, the children sat down.
As soon as he saw the dog, the child shouted.
exercises.explain: *Iti gören badyna* (as soon as he saw the dog), then *çaga gygyrdy*.

exercises.title: Wokzalda
exercises.passage:
Selbi wokzalda dostuna garaşýardy. Otly gijä galypdy. Selbi dura-dura ýadady, ýöne otly gelýänçä, hiç ýere gitmedi.

Ahyrynda otly geldi. Bahar otludan düşen badyna, Selbini gördi we oňa tarap ylgady. Olar biri-birini gujaklap, güle-güle gürleşdiler. Baharyň sumkasy agyr bolandygy üçin, olar taksi bilen öýe gaýtdylar. Olar öýe gelen badyna, Selbiniň ejesi olara çaý getirdi.
exercises.translation: Selbi was waiting for her friend at the station. The train was late. Selbi got tired of standing and standing, but she didn't go anywhere until the train came. At last the train arrived. As soon as Bahar got off the train, she saw Selbi and ran towards her. They hugged each other and talked, laughing. Because Bahar's bag was heavy, they went home by taxi. As soon as they got home, Selbi's mother brought them tea.

options: she had been standing a long time
she had run to the station
she had carried a heavy bag
as soon as she got off the train
questions.explain: *Otludan düşen badyna*: as soon as she got off.

questions.q: Why did they take a taxi?
questions.explain: *Baharyň sumkasy agyr bolandygy üçin*: because the bag was heavy.
